featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Banana Leaf – Kandivali West

Visited Banana Leaf in Kandivali West and had a very good dining experience.

🍛 Food:
Food quality was excellent with authentic South Indian taste. Wide variety of dishes available – from dosa, idli, uttapam to full meals. Must try dishes include Rajni Dosa, Podi Idli, Rasam Vada, Appam with curry, and their filter coffee. Food is fresh and well presented.

💰 Per Person Cost:
Approx ₹400–₹500 per person (₹800–₹900 for two), which is reasonable considering the quality and ambience.

🏠 Ambience:
Ambience is very nice with traditional South Indian theme, clean seating, and comfortable arrangement. Good for family dining and group visits.

👨‍🍳 Staff & Service:
Staff is polite and helpful. Service is generally quick, though can be slightly slow during peak hours due to crowd.

🚗 Valet Parking:
Valet parking facility available, which is very convenient in busy area like Kandivali/Borivali.

🧼 Cleanliness & Hygiene:
Overall cleanliness is good and well maintained. Many customers appreciate hygiene and clean serving style.

📌 Overall:
Great place for authentic South Indian food with good ambience and service. Perfect for family lunch/dinner or casual outings.

Highly recommended 👍 Must visit for South Indian food lovers.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Delicacy is one of the oldest and reputed restaurant in Kandivali West.
I decided to go for a dinner with my family to this restaurant .

They offer Veg. and Pure Jain food.
The outlet is spacious and has indoors and outdoors  seatings.
Even though there was huge rush,service wasn't delayed. Their services is very quick.
Talking about the food, we had ordered few JAIN dishes:

MANCHOW SOUP - Perfectly made, with balanced  quantity of vegetables. The quantity was fair enough.

PANEER MANCHURIAN - instead of manchurian balls they have used paneer.We can say that it's a paneer dish with gravy. The paneer was  extremely soft and the gravy was tasty. But the quantity of gravy was kinda less.

DAHI WADA - It is one of the most popular dish of this restaurant. They offer 2 huge wada in a plate of sweet dahi. The dahi was extremely delicious. One should definitely try this dish.

PIZZA - I always prefer pizza from this restaurant. Instead of mozzarella cheese, they use normal cheese cubes which tastes heavenly. It's a highly recommended dish.

BIRYANI - The biryani was very tasty and had fair enough quantity. It's recommended if you want to try some rice dish.

Overall it was a good experience.I would recommend this outlet if you are looking for a quick lunch or dinner near Kandivali west.

Visit my blog and check out my food recommendation for this outlet.

featured_reviews.name: The foodie world
featured_reviews.review_text:
Achija in Kandivali East is one of those classic family restaurants that never disappoints. While it’s most famous for its pav bhaji, my visit turned out to be a complete feast with a mix of flavors. The pav bhaji with butter garlic chutney truly lived up to the hype—rich, buttery, and perfectly spiced, with that chutney taking it to another level. The paneer hotpan was sizzling and full of flavor, while the Mexican cheese roll was cheesy, crunchy, and indulgent. For South Indian cravings, the thatte idli was soft, fluffy, and really comforting.

On the drinks side, the pink guava and peach ice tea were refreshing and balanced, and the Kit Kat shake was a fun, chocolatey treat to end the meal. Achija is definitely a place where you can enjoy a wide variety of dishes under one roof, making it perfect for family outings. The vibe is casual, the food is consistently good, and the menu has something for everyone.

I can't imagine vegan and oil free food can be so so tasty hats off to owner(Madhura) for creating so lip smacking recipes for people who wants to eat junk without guilt🙈. Every dish is awesome. I have tried everything from their menu. Personally I order pasta, loaded fries, pizza, burger, thai curry frequently from here. Their kitchen is so clean and nicely maintained always. I also order tiffin meals from here regularly sabzi, roti etc that is also very good for anyone looking to eat healthy food everyday as per diet requirement. Desserts are also very very tasty being vegan. Totally hooked by The Gratitude Kitchen🙏 and their efforts to give best every single time and their integrity towards keeping people's health in mind😊.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nirvana🍲🍜🥣🍹

Now a days while placing order for some delicious food there are always few questions behind back of our mind. Questions about the hygiene, about sanitisation and many more. But i must say Nirvana has taken care of  each and everything perfectly. From keeping hygiene taking temperature and proper sanitisation. And above all that maintain a lip smacking taste of each and every delicacies.

They have a vast menu to choose from. The food was delivered on time and in a leakage proof container. Food was hot when delivered as if it is served directly from there kitchen.

I ordered :
1) Shezwan Rice 🍚 : The rice was hot and spicy in taste. Rice was perfectly cooked with unique blend of sauces and loads of veggies.

2) Mughlai Paneer Bhuna Masala : It was rich and spicy in taste. Cubed Paneer is combined with amazing bhuna masala giving it a lip smacking taste.

Paneer Tikka Masala : Grilled chunks of paneer in spicy gravy will make your mouth water.

I overall like the taste as well as the portion of the food delivered. I definitely recommend this place.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Highly recommend!!

Main course:

Dessert:
GulabJamun with rabdi-How can we miss on an indian dessert when in a Vegetarian restaurant
This is must try.

Sizzling brownie: was nice too. The vanilla and cashew stuffed brownie

Ambience: it has a modern look with amzing interiors. The staff is cordial and quick. They served us well.

Overall i was completely satisfied with the service and quality of food they have

featured_reviews.name: Hitiksha Panchal
featured_reviews.review_text:
This location is in Kandivali East . And it’s really a very nice restaurant . Niravana is a family dining restaurant and this place can be visited with friends and with family also . They have a great variety of cuisines which is served here from starters , main course , soups , chinese , sizzlers and even the best mocktails and desserts .
Had tried as lot of varietie of cuisines here and they are just amazing .
In the mocktail had tried the kiwi stroke - this mocktail contain green apple , kiwi and soda it’s really refreshing and amazing there are small pieces of kiwi and green apple and it’s just worth trying . One of the best mocktails which is served here .
Then had tried the litchi lemonade - this mocktails contains litchi , lemon and soda . It’s just so unique and it has litchi pieces in it and the mocktail is just amazing and this one of my favourite too.
Then had tried the desi cheese fondue - this fondue is just so cheesy and yummy and it’s served with lots of cheese and bread pieces and potatoes . This is just the best combination to have .
Pizza kulchiyaan - this started is really unique and it’s hot buttery mini kulchas stuffed with pizza stuffing which is little tangy and yummy with just so soft and temption . One the most unique dish and it’s the best ans recommended.
Then the sizzlers here are also really very nice .
Had tried the Panner manchurian sizzler - this sizzler is served with Panner pieces with rice and it’s served with chilly sauce and veggies and this really tasty and topped French fries and all the stuffs in the sizzler just combine so well.
Really love the service here as it’s really good and the staff is really very polite and nice and the food served here is fresh and the quality and the quantity of the food is really great. Surely going to visit this place .

featured_reviews.name: Ronit Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text:
We were looking for a new restaurant to have dinner and then thought of trying this restaurant. The restaurant is actually a medium-sized one not too big but is well maintained.

Coming to the order we started by order Veg. Fingers for a starter. There were 10 pieces all crisp and hot. The schezwan chutney they served with those fingers truly improved the taste. The fingers were made from all kinds of veggies and I could see corns, carrots, and potato at least. All in all the taste was delicious.

Next, we ordered Veg. Chilly Milly, and Paneer Handi for the main course along with Butter Rotis and Butter Naan for the main course. The Veg. Chilly Milli was as its name on the spicier side with veggies such as French beans, carrots, cauliflower, etc. made in an orange gravy. While the paneer handi actually came in a handi and had nice big cubes of paneer. The paneer was soft and you could really enjoy chewing it. The paneer handi too was in an orange gravy but less spicy than the prior one. The taste and quantity of both were superb and a good thing was they also took care to ensure they do not add any capsicum as we had asked.

The butter rotis and butter naan were soft and were roasted perfectly. There were no black marks on any of them showing perfection. Also, there was a generous quantity of butter on the rotis and naan which really enriched the taste of the entire food. Finally, we ended the meal with a glass of sweet lime juice. Served slightly cold but was really soothing after a spice enriched food. All in all, we thoroughly enjoyed our dinner and I would definitely recommend trying out this restaurant.
